I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart assistant that has real‑time data.  

(For reference, New York City is usually 4 hours behind UTC during daylight‑saving time, and 5 hours behind UTC during standard time.)
